subject: E-Commerce
title: The First Online Sale
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The First Online Sale.

hook.text: In 1994, a man sold a Sting CD on his website NetMarket. It was the first secure online purchase ever.

buildup.text: Dan Kohn built NetMarket to test encrypted online payments. He needed proof it could work safely.

discovery.text: The CD cost $12.48 plus shipping. The buyer's credit card was encrypted with PGP. The future had arrived.

twist.text: Pizza Hut also claims the first sale. They took online orders in 1994 too, but payment was at the door.

climax.text: That single $12.48 transaction proved a concept now worth $6 trillion per year globally.

punchline.text: A $12.48 CD started a $6 trillion industry. One click changed everything.

quiz.question: What was reportedly the first item sold securely online?
